1434399719376175104.a: What am I up to tonight? Good question. #making new equipment out of old equipment. I noticed this old Chinese drill press was not a drill press. They dressed it up as one but it has thrust bearings and a chuck that will vertical mill and the speeds are right. t.co

1434399722085789697.a: We are extending the pipe from 18 to 24 inches and making a plate to align the table mount to the foot of the stand. Just wood, PE, or light brass. XY table makes patterns repeatable. Great for forstner bits. Yellow gear drives Z axis; spring and lever is intact. #Mechaduino FTW!

1434399723578961925.a: So, what's with the Mechaduino and gear? Torque hold. Hold and release to set the min/max depth. Zeroing the index. Pecking. Setting the feed speed by just moving the handle at that rate and hitting continue at the same speed; or mm/min. Accurate depth gauge and drill stop. gcode

1434400806900490246.a: The table will get torn down for cleaning once I know it will fit and work for sure. The table is from another drill press that was converted to mill by an old guy who made RC planes. The taller pipe will also allow the regular table to be used if desired. Swings out of the way.
